note: First published schema of the nexus job status --json document (BG-1), generated from JobStatusDocument in cli/src/core/job_receipt.ts on release/v1.3.0: schema_version, the job record, a summary of the job's operation (id, status, origin, unit statuses) or null, and the job's receipt or null. Nothing was published before it.

BG-2: the status document embeds the job receipt, whose `missed` is now null or an object and which gains the optional `schedule_occurrence` (see JOB_RECEIPT_VERSIONS.json). Version stays 1 for the same reason: nothing the previous entry published changed meaning, and no release carried the earlier shape.
